highlight: Still signs in after Apple’s latest change: since mid-October 2026, Apple refuses the anisette data that nearly every free sideloader relied on, and their sign-in failed with “This action cannot be completed at this time. (-80045)”. ModStaller now gets its anisette data from a server running a Mac ADI (by default mac-ani.jkcoxson.com), which Apple still accepts – your Apple ID and password never go there.
items: Certificate slots full? Instead of pointing to the command line, ModStaller now lets you pick which certificate of another tool to revoke – and tries again right away.
iOS 27: IPAs whose extensions were removed no longer fail with “Failed to unarchive journal entry data”.
When Apple ends the session, ModStaller takes you back to the sign-in form – with your Apple ID already filled in.
